cc:Work.dc:title: Teacher table VP
cc:Work.dc:description: Trailing 10-iteration final VP per seat, pooled by table count across training and held-out teacher tables. Series distinguish cotton-targeted tables, standard exploration, and all tables. Full history plots all 230 recorded iterations with up to 40 markers per curve. Recent detail spans g2051–g2250 with 200 recorded iterations, actual generation spacing and up to 30 markers per curve.
